output.body:

I saw your note that it wasn’t a priority during the migration.
Now you can start building pipeline without adding SDR headcount, avoiding the stall that generic sequences cause.
Would you be open to a brief 15‑minute call to explore how Halyard can feed your HubSpot data into an outbound engine?
